about: Synthetic Studease backlog for `seed load` (see #11, #12). Requests are in submission order; daysAgo is relative to the load. `problem` (intended Problem key, null for spam) and `kind` (hard case) are the answer key: never stored and never shown to the AI. Actions point at a Problem by one of its requests' titles.

requests.title: Cafe was way too loud
requests.description: I went to the cafe the app rated 4.8 for studying and it was the loudest place I've ever been. Music blasting, a blender every two minutes, a birthday party in the corner. The rating was clearly from people who like the coffee, not people who need to concentrate. I wasted my whole afternoon. Ratings are useless for studying unless they tell me how loud it is. Please add a noise level that people can report, and show it on the spot page, ideally for different times of day because it's quiet in the morning and a zoo at lunch. Until then I can't trust the recommendations.

requests.title: Walked 20 minutes to a closed library AGAIN
requests.description: This is the third time this month. The app said the Engineering library was a great spot, I walked 20 minutes in the rain with my laptop, and it was closed because it's a holiday week. Nothing in the app told me. I don't understand how an app for finding study spots doesn't know when the spots are open. Every other maps app shows hours. I had a problem set due at 9am and ended up working on the floor of a hallway. Please, please add opening hours and let me filter by them, or at least show a big warning when a place is closed. I love the idea of this app but I'm about to delete it.

requests.title: The info on this app is so wrong
requests.description: I've been using Studease all semester and I'm honestly tired of it. Half the spots have the wrong building, the 'has wifi' on the Law library is false, and the cafe by the station closed in September but it's still the top result. I tried to fix it but there's no edit button unless you added the spot yourself, and the person who added it obviously isn't coming back. There's no report button, no feedback link, nothing. It feels like nobody maintains it. Give us a way to fix wrong details, or at least flag them, and let the community keep it up to date. Otherwise the whole thing falls apart.
